csv_project_name: Design for I-435 Route 45 Bike / Pedestrian Connections
csv_scope_of_work: Platte County, Missouri is requesting the services of a consulting engineering firm to provide professional design services for improvements to provide bicycle and pedestrian facilities along Route 45 at the I-435 interchange between Homer Parkway and NW Brink Meyer Road. If your firm would like to be considered for these consulting services, you may submit your letter of interest to Platte County.
